title: Characterization Step (Simplified Input)
description: A user-friendly form to describe a single characterization step (measurement, test, or analysis). Provide a name, the specimens or materials being characterised, any quantitative test conditions, and scalar results. Automatically converted to a standardised RDF representation (OBI/PMDCo OO-LD).

step_name.title: Step Name
step_name.description: A human-readable name for this characterization step. Example: 'Tensile test specimen 1', 'Vickers hardness batch A'.

step_id.title: Step ID
step_id.description: Optional. Identifier (IRI slug) for this step in the RDF graph. Auto-derived from step_name if omitted.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text description of this characterization step.

inputs.title: Specimen / Material IRIs
inputs.description: IRIs of the specimens or materials being characterised (obi:has_specified_input).

outputs.title: Output Dataset / Specimen IRIs
outputs.description: IRIs of datasets or post-test specimens produced by this step (obi:has_specified_output).

measurement_device.title: Measurement Device IRI
measurement_device.description: IRI of the measurement-device KItem used to perform this characterization step (chameo:usesInstrument).

preceded_by.title: Preceded By (Step IRIs)
preceded_by.description: IRIs of characterization steps that directly precede this one.

conditions.title: Test Conditions / Parameters
conditions.description: Quantitative conditions under which this step is carried out. Each entry: name (parameter label), value (number), unit (vocabulary label or QUDT IRI).

type_iri.title: Parameter Type IRI
type_iri.description: Optional explicit IRI override for rdf:type. If omitted, the name is used as vocabulary label.

results.title: Measured Results
results.description: Scalar results from this characterization step. Each entry becomes a MeasurementDatum (IAO_0000109) in the RDF graph. name: property label; value: numeric magnitude; unit: vocabulary label or QUDT IRI.
